name: Watch Yer Back
summary: Sully McCleary asks you to meet him by a graveyard outside town. He wants you to hear more about your mission while avoiding a tail.

sections.title: A Quiet Meeting
sections.body: Sully McCleary plans to leave through the door behind you. Once he is gone, you are to meet him behind the graveyard outside town and make sure no one follows.

sections.title: The Next Word
sections.body: In Dustwallow Marsh, Sully McCleary tells you to investigate a tower and learn what you can. The work now turns on what you find there.

faq.q: Who is asking me to meet him?
faq.answer: Sully McCleary asks you to meet him behind the graveyard outside town.
Meet Sully behind the graveyard outside town after he has left through the door behind you.

faq.q: Why should I make sure no one follows?
faq.answer: Sully tells you to ensure you are not followed before meeting him.

faq.q: What does Sully want me to do next?
faq.answer: Sully asks you to sneak into a tower and find out what you can.

attribution: In-game quest text: Watch Yer Back
